positive_below_margin.boundary: strict: exactly 0 is not positive; the next float above 0 is

chart.bar: largest strictly positive finite H1 lifetime; ties birth asc, death asc, index asc
chart.scale: midpoint (birth + death) / 2; edges with distance <= scale
chart.lift_solver: scipy.optimize.milp, zero objective, integrality all, threads 1, mip_rel_gap 0, presolve default
chart.gauge: fit_gauge(chart, m32[C*]) unchanged: s in (+1,-1) maximizing |mean(exp(i*s*phi) * conj(m32x + i*m32y))| over the C* landmarks; tie s=+1; phi <- (s*phi - arg(c)) mod 2pi; |c| finite and > 0; no other alignment threshold
chart.sigma: median(d8) over the charted landmarks C*: d8_i = 8th smallest distance from charted landmark i to the other charted landmarks (self excluded only)
chart.duplicate_rule: query with an exact zero distance: z = mean of exp(i*phi_j) over ALL landmarks at distance exactly 0; Invalid if 1 - |z| > 1e-8
chart.inherited_from: tools/c1prime/CONTRACT.json chart section at R_ref c460e24 (kernel keys, giant, val_support copied verbatim; equality checked by k4b_config.check_chart_equality); the frozen C1' CONTRACT is not edited
chart.landmarks: production: the 512 lowest-sequence_id rows of k4b cal b0 (3,072 rows), every sampled row; direct comparator: the 512 lowest-sequence_id rows of k4b val b0; step-0 control: the same 512 cal b0 landmarks; natural float64 resid_post_3/p32 activations; landmark_ids = 20-digit zero-padded sequence_id strings, ascending
chart.restriction: largest connected component C* of ({0..511}, edge_list(D, r)); ties to the component containing the smallest landmark index
chart.support_radius: 2 * quantile(d8, 0.99, method=inverted_cdf), d8 over D[np.ix_(C*, C*)]
chart.fidelity_domain: the direct chart's C*_val rows, in its landmark order, unmasked
chart.support_rule: C0-val: >= 507/512 supported (not every row); no fresh-test support gate (protocol 10)
chart.gate_rules: C0-cal: GIANT, lift, primitive, smoothing, gauge alignment finite > 0; C0-val: direct GIANT, support >= 507/512, fidelity >= 0.80, every bin >= 8, overall resultant <= 0.30; unmet -> INCONCLUSIVE/CHART_UNAVAILABLE

annotations.POSITIVE_BELOW_MARGIN_EXCLUDE: positive, and certified below the margin
annotations.POSITIVE_BELOW_MARGIN_UNRESOLVED: positive, not resolved against the margin

licences.SUPPORT: In each of three transformers trained by the E4 recipe in world w* (12 x 12 cylinder, stay probability 0.2, emission width 1.75; masters 620301/620302/620303, step 5000, resid_post_3, position 32), the gauged phase of a chart built by the LCC >= 95 % rule on fresh calibration histories covaries with the first-harmonic oracle residual r4 = m32 - m4 on {N} fresh stationary test histories. For every assignment of unit coordinates to the unsupported rows ({a}/{N}, {b}/{N}, {c}/{N}), the one-sided (1 - 0.05/3) lower bound of E[u.r4] under the documented law exceeds 0.01 after the certified margin F (values {values}; B4 = {B4}; oracle comparator Delta4_orc = {delta4_orc} on the same rows). Every function of the last four observations has zero population covariance with r4 under that law, so on its supported rows this coordinate is not a function of the last four observations: it depends on earlier observations, in a direction aligned with the oracle belief residual.
licences.EXCLUSION: For this chart rule, site and world, in each of the three models the covariance of the chart phase with r4 lies within (-0.01, 0.01) for every completion of unsupported rows, under the documented law, at the stated nominal levels (bounds {values}; B4 = {B4}; Delta4_orc = {delta4_orc} on the same rows). Covariance of either sign at or beyond 0.01 is excluded.
licences.EXCLUSION_ORACLE_SENTENCE: These learned circles did not carry, in the measured direction, beyond-four information that the belief carried on these rows.
licences.EXCLUSION_TAIL: In either case EXCLUSION still does not establish suffix-only dependence.
licences.POSITIVE_BELOW_MARGIN: In model(s) {models}, the chart phase covaries positively with r4 for every completion (one-sided (1 - 0.05/3) lower bound > 0 after F).
licences.POSITIVE_BELOW_MARGIN_EXCLUDE: Its upper bound after F is below the registered margin 0.01: a positive effect, certified smaller than the margin.
licences.POSITIVE_BELOW_MARGIN_UNRESOLVED: Its lower bound does not exceed 0.01: a positive finding below the margin, neither SUPPORT nor evidence of a negligible effect.
licences.MIXED: Only the recorded per-model results and the identified limitations.
licences.INCONCLUSIVE: Only the recorded per-model results and the identified limitations.
licences.INCONCLUSIVE/NOT_LEARNED: Under the unchanged E4 recipe, {k} of 3 new models did not reach captured 0.8 on 4,096 fresh histories in w*. The beyond-four question was not tested.
licences.INCONCLUSIVE/CHART_UNAVAILABLE: The models learned (L1 PASS), but in model {models} the K4b chart rule did not yield a chart passing C0-cal/C0-val (criterion {criterion}) on fresh histories.
licences.INCONCLUSIVE/<K4b reason>: Only the recorded per-model results and the identified limitations.

scratch_rules.fixture_components: an EXCLUSION row's extra fixture path components (e.g. 'pytest' for test_hwsb-*)
scratch_rules.top_level_array_files: none on 2026-10-29; any array file directly under the scratch root -> INCONCLUSIVE/REGISTRY_INCOMPLETE
